description: Remove permissions from the app manifest
name: Remove Permissions

options.description: Comma-separated permission names to remove from the manifest
options.title: Permissions to remove

description: Remove uses-feature entries so the app installs on more devices
name: Remove Hardware Requirements

options.description: Comma-separated feature names to remove; leave empty to remove all uses-feature entries
options.title: Features to remove

description: Remove screenOrientation locks so the app rotates freely
name: Unlock Rotation

description: Force the app to a fixed screen orientation
name: Force Landscape / Portrait

options.description: Force a fixed screen orientation on all activities
options.title: Orientation

description: Sets android:debuggable so debuggers and profiling tools can attach
name: Make App Debuggable

description: Overrides the android:versionCode declared in the manifest
name: Change Version Code

options.description: New version code. Use -1 (default) to keep the original.
options.title: Version code

description: Overrides the android:versionName declared in the manifest
name: Change Version Name

options.description: New version name (e.g. 2.5.1). Leave empty to keep the original.
options.title: Version name

description: Overrides the launcher label of the app
name: Rename App

options.description: New launcher name. Leave empty to keep the original.
options.title: App name

description: Replaces the launcher icon with a transparent drawable
name: Remove App Icon

description: Sets android:usesCleartextTraffic and drops any network security config so plain HTTP requests are allowed (useful for debugging through local proxies)
name: Allow Cleartext Traffic

description: Adds android:keepScreenOn to every theme so the display stays on while any activity of the app is visible
name: Keep Screen On

description: Sets android:allowBackup and removes data extraction / full backup rules that exclude app data from device transfers and cloud backups
name: Remove Backup Restrictions

description: Makes all activities launchable by other apps and ADB.
name: Export All Activities

description: Adds missing android:exported to components with intent filters so the app installs on newer Android.
name: Repair Missing Component Export Flags

description: Removes the permission and intent filters apps use to ask for battery optimization exemptions, so the 'Ignore battery optimizations?' dialog never appears
name: Disable Battery Optimization Prompt

description: Removes the app's network security config so certificate pinning and cleartext restrictions fall back to platform defaults (useful for HTTPS inspection)
name: Remove Network Security Config

description: Sets android:largeHeap so the app gets a bigger Java heap on devices that allow it, reducing OutOfMemoryError crashes in memory-hungry games
name: Enable Large Heap

description: Sets android:hardwareAccelerated so every activity renders with GPU acceleration, even when the app disables it globally
name: Force Hardware Acceleration

description: Asks the system to use ANGLE for better graphics on supported devices.
name: Prefer ANGLE Graphics Driver

description: Sets android:requestLegacyExternalStorage so the app keeps using the classic shared-storage model instead of scoped storage (Android 10; ignored on 11+)
name: Legacy External Storage

description: Adds storage permissions so old apps can access files on newer Android.
name: Ensure Storage Permissions

description: Adds media permissions so old apps can access photos and videos on Android 13+.
name: Ensure Modern Media Permissions

description: Lets old apps see all installed apps on Android 11+.
name: Restore Package Visibility

description: Sets android:hasFragileUserData so Android offers to keep the app's data when uninstalling (the confirmation dialog appears on Android 10+)
name: Keep Data on Uninstall

description: Overrides the android:installLocation declared in the manifest
name: Set Install Location

options.description: Where Android prefers to install the app.
options.title: Install location

description: Sets android:resizeableActivity and supportsFreeformWindowManagement so the app can run in split-screen, free-form windows, DeX, and Chromebooks
name: Force Resizable Activity

options.description: Also set supportsFreeformWindowManagement for true free-form.
options.title: Enable freeform

description: Adds android:windowFullscreen to every theme so activities render edge-to-edge without the status bar
name: Immersive Fullscreen

description: Deletes all translated resources so only the default language remains, reducing APK size. Android falls back to the default strings automatically.
name: Strip Translations

description: Replaces framework Vibrator.vibrate calls with no-ops so apps cannot make the device buzz
name: Disable Vibration

description: Blocks crash reporting so the app doesn't send crash logs.
name: Disable Crash Reporters

description: Removes android:autoVerify from intent filters so Android stops prompting to verify the app's web domains and never converts links into app opens
name: Disable App Links Verification

description: Removes compatible-screens restrictions and marks every screen size supported so the app installs on devices it would otherwise reject
name: Support All Screens

description: Strips Privacy Sandbox (AdServices) permissions, the ad ID permission and their config metadata from the manifest
name: Remove Ad Services Entries

description: Sets android:autoRevokePermissions to discouraged so Android stops resetting unused permissions of apps you rarely open
name: Disable Permission Auto-Revoke

description: Adds the INTERNET permission if it is missing. Useful after aggressive permission stripping or for offline builds that still need web endpoints
name: Ensure Internet Permission

description: Adds notification permission for old apps on Android 13+.
name: Ensure Notification Permission

description: Forces the status bar and navigation bar icon color in every theme. Pick white icons for dark backgrounds or dark icons for light backgrounds
name: Status Bar Icons

options.description: Color of the system bar icons while the app is open.
options.title: Icon color

description: Makes connectivity checks report an active connection: WifiManager.isWifiEnabled, NetworkInfo.isConnected/isAvailable/isConnectedOrConnecting all return true
name: Fake Online State

description: Adds <profileable android:shell="true"/> so profilers (Android Studio, simpleperf, Perfetto) can attach to release builds for performance analysis
name: Set Profileable

description: Sets android:extractNativeLibs so native libraries are extracted at install time. Some mod loaders, hooks and older tools only work with extracted libs
name: Force Extract Native Libs

description: Removes maxAspectRatio limits from the application, activities and metadata so the app fills tall edge-to-edge screens instead of letterboxing
name: Unlock Max Aspect Ratio

description: Makes NetworkCapabilities report no VPN: hasTransport always returns false and hasCapability always returns true, so apps cannot block or alter behavior on VPN
name: Bypass VPN Detection

description: Replaces common android.os.Build fields (model, manufacturer, brand) with custom values. Leave an option empty to keep the original value
name: Spoof Device Model

options.description: Build.MODEL, e.g. Pixel 10 Pro XL. Empty keeps the original.
options.title: Model

options.description: Build.MANUFACTURER, e.g. Google. Empty keeps the original.
options.title: Manufacturer

options.description: Build.BRAND, e.g. google. Empty keeps the original.
options.title: Brand

description: No-ops the certificate verification entry points of bundled OkHttp clients so certificate pinning never rejects connections
name: Bypass OkHttp Pinning

description: No-ops the check methods of app-bundled X509TrustManager implementations so custom certificate validation (including pinning reimplemented by hand) accepts anything
name: Trust User Certificates

description: Replaces every read of Build.FINGERPRINT with a custom value, useful for integrity and device checks. Leave empty to keep the original fingerprint
name: Spoof Build Fingerprint

options.description: A full Android build fingerprint, e.g. google/mustang/mustang:17/CP2A.260605.012/15430684:user/release-keys
options.title: Fingerprint

description: Sets android:appCategory to game so Android applies game mode, battery and screenshot optimizations tuned for games
name: Optimize as Game

description: Marks every <uses-library> entry as optional so missing shared libraries no longer block the app from installing on devices that lack them
name: Relax Shared Libraries

description: Forces the status bar and navigation bar to render transparent in every theme so app content draws edge-to-edge behind them
name: Transparent System Bars

description: Shows a customizable toast message every time the app starts
name: Custom Startup Toast

options.description: Text shown in the toast on every app start.
options.title: Toast message

options.description: How long the toast stays visible.
options.title: Duration

description: Shows a customizable dialog once when the app is opened
name: Custom Startup Dialog

options.default: This app has been modified by Nai's Patches.
options.description: Body text of the startup dialog.
options.title: Dialog message

options.description: Allow closing the dialog with the back button or outside taps.
options.title: Dismissable

description: Turns on WebView remote debugging: existing setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled calls are forced to true and it is actively enabled at startup, so WebViews can be inspected via chrome://inspect
name: Enable WebView Debugging

description: Makes PowerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations report a chosen state so apps stop nagging about battery optimization exemptions
name: Fake Battery Whitelist

description: Makes PackageManager.checkSignatures always return SIGNATURE_MATCH so apps that verify their own or another package's signature accept any build
name: Spoof Signature Match

description: Makes ConnectivityManager.isActiveNetworkMetered always return false so apps lift download restrictions and quality caps on mobile data
name: Treat Network as Unmetered

description: Makes Environment.isExternalStorageManager always return true so apps accept the storage permission state without the special Android 11+ prompt
name: Grant All-Files Access

description: Makes exact alarms appear available so old alarm apps keep working.
name: Ensure Exact Alarm Availability

description: Makes TelephonyManager.isNetworkRoaming always return false so apps that block or warn while roaming behave as if the device is on its home network
name: Hide Roaming Status

description: Makes PowerManager.isPowerSaveMode and isDeviceIdleMode always return false so apps do not throttle features or downloads while battery saver or Doze is active
name: Ignore Power Save Mode

description: Makes the app think notifications are enabled so it keeps working even if blocked.
name: Spoof Notifications as Enabled

description: Makes KeyguardManager lock-state checks report an unlocked device so apps that gate features behind a screen lock behave as if none is set
name: Ignore Screen Lock

description: Makes LocationManager.isProviderEnabled always return true so apps that refuse to run without location services keep working
name: Ignore GPS Disabled

description: Makes Location.isMock and Location.isFromMockProvider always return false so apps cannot detect spoofed GPS apps
name: Hide Mock Location

description: Makes the app think it passed Google's device check.
name: Spoof Play Integrity

description: Forces Google Play's license (LVL) check to pass, so the app does not refuse to run on unlicensed or modified builds.
name: Bypass License Verification

description: Tricks the app into thinking Google Play Services is installed and working, so it does not disable features that depend on it.
name: Bypass Google Play Services Check

description: Set a custom resolution for the game
name: Custom App Resolution (Experimental)

options.description: Override the game's window size with the width and height below
options.title: Enable Custom Resolution

description: Remove the screenshot-blocking window flag
name: Allow Screenshots

description: Skip or shorten splash screen delays
name: Skip Splash Screen (Experimental)

description: Disable root detection
name: Disable Root Checks

description: Block analytics and tracking
name: Disable Telemetry

options.description: Google's analytics and crash reporting suite
options.title: Block Firebase Analytics

options.description: Block any remaining analytics via generic logEvent detection (may be aggressive)
options.title: Block Generic Analytics

description: Makes dark mode pure black for AMOLED screens. Light mode stays normal.
name: AMOLED Theme

options.description: Hex color to use for AMOLED (e.g. #FF000000 pure black, #FF0A0A0A near-black).
options.title: AMOLED color

options.description: Also force the status bar background to AMOLED on dark themes.
options.title: Blacken Status Bar

options.description: Also force the navigation bar background to AMOLED on dark themes.
options.title: Blacken Navigation Bar

options.description: Also blacken Material3 surface container colors (recommended for full AMOLED).
options.title: Blacken Surfaces

description: Makes ActivityManager.isBackgroundRestricted always return false so apps ignore background activity restrictions imposed by the system or user
name: Allow Background Activity

description: Sets android:allowClearUserData so the system's Clear Data button stays available even for apps that try to disable it
name: Allow Clearing App Data

description: Forces WebSettings.setMixedContentMode(MIXED_CONTENT_ALWAYS_ALLOW) so WebViews load HTTP resources on HTTPS pages.
name: Allow Mixed Content

description: Bandcamp: allows audio cache downloads over mobile data without the confirmation dialog.
name: Allow Mobile Downloads

description: Makes protected text selectable and copyable.
name: Allow Text Selection

description: Forces WebSettings.setMediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture(false) so media in WebViews can autoplay without a tap.
name: Allow WebView Autoplay

description: Forces WebSettings file-access flags on so WebViews can load local files and content URLs.
name: Allow WebView File Access

description: Makes BiometricManager.canAuthenticate always return BIOMETRIC_SUCCESS so apps do not block biometric features on unsupported or unenrolled devices
name: Always Allow Biometrics

description: Forces scrollbars to stay enabled so scroll position is always visible
name: Always Show Scrollbars

description: Removes unused CPU libraries to shrink the APK. Keep only your device's architecture.
name: Apk Junk Cleanup

options.description: Native libraries for other ABIs under lib/ will be deleted.
options.title: Keep architecture

description: Stops app performance monitoring SDKs so timings, crashes and network traces never upload
name: Block APM Suites

options.description: Observability and real user monitoring SDK.
options.title: Block Datadog

description: Stops smaller ad networks missed by Disable Ad SDK Init so their SDKs never initialize or serve ads
name: Block Ad Network Extras

description: Stops smaller product analytics SDKs so events never reach their dashboards
name: Block Analytics Long Tail

description: Stops smaller attribution SDKs so installs and opens are never credited to ad networks
name: Block Attribution Extras

description: Blocks Bluetooth Low Energy scans so apps cannot track nearby beacons or accessories
name: Block BLE Scan

description: Stops smaller crash reporters missed by Disable Crash Reporters so stack traces never upload
name: Block Crash Extras

options.description: Microsoft App Center crashes and analytics.
options.title: Block App Center

description: Stops customer data pipeline SDKs so events never stream into warehouses or profiles
name: Block Data Pipelines

description: Blocks Google activity recognition and geofencing so apps cannot track movement or location zones
name: Block GMS Tracking

options.description: Stop walking, driving and stillness detection requests.
options.title: Block activity recognition

options.description: Stop enter and exit tracking for location zones.
options.title: Block geofencing

description: Stops Huawei Analytics event uploads so usage never reaches Huawei servers
name: Block Huawei Analytics

description: Blocks the Play Install Referrer API so apps cannot read which ad or link installed them
name: Block Install Referrer

description: Stops pre-Firebase Google Analytics so screen views and hits never upload
name: Block Legacy Analytics

description: Stops location intelligence SDKs so visits and beacon sightings never upload
name: Block Location Trackers

description: Stops the MoEngage SDK so events and profile traits never reach its engagement cloud
name: Block MoEngage

description: Stops the PostHog SDK so captures, screens and feature flags never upload
name: Block PostHog

description: Stops user profile stitching in analytics SDKs whose events are blocked but identity calls are not
name: Block Profile Tracking

options.description: Amplitude user ID and property setters.
options.title: Block Amplitude identity

description: Block push notification ads (Firebase Cloud Messaging). Also blocks legitimate notifications.
name: Block Push Ads

description: Stops push engagement SDKs so tags, outcomes and identity never reach push vendors
name: Block Push Analytics

options.description: Push engagement SDK, formerly Urban Airship.
options.title: Block Airship

options.description: Messaging and engagement SDK, formerly Appboy.
options.title: Block Braze

description: Adds FLAG_SECURE to every activity window so the system blocks screenshots, screen recording and recents previews of the app
name: Block Screenshot Detection
